fields.description: World 0 progress record: first 8-byte entry of the 32-byte save payload. Completion flag for world index 0 is tested at entry byte +6 bit 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_080071dc computes *(byte *)((param_1 & 0xff) * 8 + base + 6) & 1; callers pass index 0 (lines 3269, 3278, 3366, 3419). Entry 0 of the slot payload starts at save offset 0x1F88 (logical).
fields.name: world0_progress_record

fields.description: World 1 progress record: second 8-byte entry of the 32-byte save payload. Completion flag for world index 1 is tested at entry byte +6 bit 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_080071dc computes *(byte *)((param_1 & 0xff) * 8 + base + 6) & 1; callers pass index 1 (lines 3269, 3278, 3366, 3419). Entry 1 of the slot payload starts at save offset 0x1F90 (logical).
fields.name: world1_progress_record

fields.description: World 2 progress record: third 8-byte entry of the 32-byte save payload. Completion flag for world index 2 is tested at entry byte +6 bit 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_080071dc computes *(byte *)((param_1 & 0xff) * 8 + base + 6) & 1; callers pass index 2 (lines 3270, 3280, 3367, 3420). Entry 2 of the slot payload starts at save offset 0x1F98 (logical).
fields.name: world2_progress_record

fields.description: Stored gameplay counter inside the fourth 8-byte payload entry (slot +0x18). Fresh-save init writes 1000 here; baseline holds 1000 (0x3E8) in all three slots.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006080 fresh-save path writes *(undefined4 *)(save_struct + 0x18) = 1000 (line 2493); value persists at save offsets 0x1FA0/0x1FC8/0x1FF0 (logical) in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: starting_counter

fields.description: Trailing 4 bytes of the fourth 8-byte payload entry (slot +0x1C). All zeros in baseline; reserved/unused.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006080 checksums a 0x20-byte payload and FUN_08006fd4 stores it verbatim; bytes at slot +0x1C..+0x1F are zero in all three baseline slots (offsets 0x1FA4, 0x1FCC, 0x1FF4 logical).
fields.name: record3_reserved

fields.description: Slot 0 integrity checksum: (sum of the 32 payload bytes + seed 0x25) & 0xFFFF. Baseline: payload sums to 235, +37 = 272 (0x0110).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006080 accumulates 0x20 payload bytes plus 2 stored bytes onto seed 0x25 (lines 2454-2483) and compares against bytes at slot +0x20; FUN_08006fd4 rebuilds the same checksum (lines 2535-2562). Verified at save offset 0x1FA8 (logical) in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot0_checksum

fields.description: Slot 0 block padding: 6 zero bytes rounding the 34 meaningful bytes up to 5 EEPROM blocks (40 bytes). Written from the memset-zeroed tail of the save buffer.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006fd4 writes (0x22 + 7) >> 3 = 5 EEPROM blocks per slot via FUN_08064188/FUN_08064054 (lines 2571-2574); bytes at 0x1FAA..0x1FAF (logical) are zero in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot0_padding

fields.description: Mirror of starting_counter in redundant slot 1 (slot +0x18). Baseline holds 1000, matching slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006fd4 writes 3 redundant slot copies (uVar10 0..2, lines 2570-2577) through FUN_08064188/FUN_08064054; mirror value 1000 verified at save offset 0x1FC8 (logical).
fields.name: starting_counter_copy1

fields.description: Slot 1 integrity checksum, same formula as slot 0. Baseline: 272 (0x0110).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006080 verifies each redundant slot with the seed-0x25 checksum loop (lines 2448-2484, retry iVar8 += 5); verified at save offset 0x1FD0 (logical) in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot1_checksum

fields.description: Mirror of starting_counter in redundant slot 2 (slot +0x18). Baseline holds 1000, matching slots 0 and 1.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006fd4 writes 3 redundant slot copies (uVar10 0..2, lines 2570-2577) through FUN_08064188/FUN_08064054; mirror value 1000 verified at save offset 0x1FF0 (logical).
fields.name: starting_counter_copy2

fields.description: Slot 2 integrity checksum, same formula as slot 0. Baseline: 272 (0x0110).
fields.evidence: FUN_08006080 verifies each redundant slot with the seed-0x25 checksum loop (lines 2448-2484, retry iVar8 += 5); verified at save offset 0x1FF8 (logical) in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot2_checksum
